text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Ines Fujin and I were set to work 
part-time as lifeguards on a deserted 
island—

text_block_list.name: Lifesaver
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the workshop! Let's all do 
our best to make sure everyone can safely 
enjoy the sea!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, there's so much to take notes on! 
Trainer, did you get all that down?
choice_data_list:
Of course! It was all a great learning 
experience, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, love the enthusiasm! Well then, I'm 
counting on you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me over there~! Did you drink 
alcohol? Then please hold off on swimming! 
Go enjoy the water once you've sobered up!
choice_data_list:
You over there, do your warm-ups before 
swimming!

You over there, do your warm-ups before 
swimming too!

text_block_list.name: Cheeky Child
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Such a hassle! I've got a swim ring, 
so it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's just like this mister says~! If you 
jump in suddenly, you might get a cramp in 
your leg!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's just like this lady says~! If you 
jump in suddenly, you might get a cramp in 
your leg!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And so, here's to making great memories! 
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is that child lost, I wonder?
choice_data_list:
She said she lost her mom near the beach 
house.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, it's really crowded, isn't it! It's 
okay, it's okay! You're safe now! Hello 
there, little guy. How old are you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This is a lost child announcement. A 
4-year-old boy wearing blue swimwear is 
looking for his mother. If you recognize 
this description—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, all set! Your mommy will be 
here soon! Why don't you wait here with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin crisply and efficiently handles 
a wide variety of tasks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I turned my gaze back toward the 
ocean— I spotted a lone, child-sized swim 
ring floating in the water.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she was "just swept along," that's 
fine. However, what was covered in the 
earlier seminar crosses my mind—

text_block_list.name: Lifesaver
text_block_list.text:
—Please keep a particularly close eye on 
your children. Drowning often happens 
silently, which can lead to delays in 
noticing them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âIn that instant, I dashed forward. 
Clutching the rescue gear, I dove into the 
ocean and searched directly beneath the 
lifebuoy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer!? What's wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ――! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She swam over and took the child from me. 
Just as I breathed a sigh of relief... a 
sharp, thread-taut pain shot through my 
leg.
...Trai... ner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Thank goodness, you're awake!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, I was so worried~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right after I hauled her to shore, this 
time Trainer was the one sinking!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I hurried back as fast as I could, you 
know? *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...What a relief...
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, didn't mean to make you worry.
...Sorry, I made you worry, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I did my warm-ups. And yet, despite 
knowing full well that diving suddenly 
into cold water makes you prone to leg 
cramps...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really. As long as you're safe, 
that's what matters! Don't look so down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, if she hadn't come for me like 
that... the mere thought sent a chill down 
my spine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, geez!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sure, maybe I've gotten myself into a 
pinch too. But so what? Is that something 
to be ashamed of?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, is it? You're the hero 
who saved that girl, aren't you? ...If you 
don't think so, then I'll say it for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —You are cool!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "So smile! Come on, say cheese!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "So smile! Come on, say cheese!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Don't you think it's nice to have a 
hero who saves other heroes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Nishi!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about thanking me! Instead, 
let's keep working hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! No matter what happens... 
I'll always be by your side!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Don't tell me you don't believe what 
I'm saying~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to listen obediently to 
your big sis, you know? ...Just kidding!
